text:
olivia_sales: Passing Pulseleaf (midmarket, ~$85k ARR) over to CS for activation. Signed PO in place, go-live target 2026-04-07. Main risks: SSO (SAML) not configured yet, and a custom API connector for embeddings is still pending. They initially asked about VPC/Private but want to try hosted first. Owners below.

olivia_sales: Quick context: customer uses Okta, expects attributes email/firstName/lastName. Primary contact is kate@pulseleaf.com. Please prioritize SSO so they can invite users.

rahul_cs: Thanks Olivia — I'll own the onboarding. @devon_support can you pick up the SSO ticket and start metadata exchange? @sasha_eng can you triage the API connector ETA and any schema mapping needs? Also scheduling a 30m kickoff — propose Thu 3pm PT.

devon_support: On it. I'll open an infra ticket and request SAML IdP metadata and the SP ACS URL. Do we have customer SP metadata or should I ask Kate for it?

olivia_sales: Sending SP metadata now — Okta admin portal link: https://okta.pulseleaf.com/admin/app/12345/sso/saml/metadata (shared with Kate). They prefer email match on attribute `email`.

sasha_eng: I'll review the connector. Quick clarifying q: is data routed through hosted Redwood API or do we plan a dedicated pool? That affects perf and CORS/egress setup. @olivia_sales you said hosted first — confirm.

olivia_sales: Confirm hosted first for initial ramp. They'll assess latency; threshold is ~200ms p95 for generation. Also flagged compliance: they need tokenized transcripts retained for 365d.

rahul_cs: Noted — I'll add a compliance checkbox to the runbook. Action items and owners: 1) Devon — create INF ticket + request metadata (INF-4523). 2) Sasha — review connector + deliver schema mapping ETA. 3) Rahul — schedule kickoff Thu 3pm PT, invite Kate + SE. 4) Olivia — share Okta admin contact and any existing test credentials. Renewal watch: renewal in ~11 months, currently medium risk due to onboarding/usage ramp. :thumbsup:

devon_support: INF-4523 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4523. I pinged kate@pulseleaf.com for metadata and cert. Will attempt initial SAML test within 24h after metadata arrives.

sasha_eng: Rough estimate: 2-3 business days to review connector and post a small PR with mapping notes. If hosted API requires a CORS proxy or custom header pass-through, that'll add eng time — will call out in review.

rahul_cs: I'll update the onboarding checklist (midmarket_sso_v1) and add this to the CS dashboard under "Onboarding in progress". Capture feedback loop item: create Gainsight record `pulseleaf-onboard-2026` to track feature asks and docs gaps.

olivia_sales: Thanks — customer expects to ramp within 2 weeks of SSO being green. I'm on standby for any contract/PO clarifications. :party:

enablement_bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist template applied — `midmarket_sso_v1`.
